description: Conference photo and notebook are authentic owner-context records. Polymer visualizations are physically motivated, unverified conceptual designs.
release_rights: Owner archive photos still require confirmation of rights for individuals appearing in the group photograph.
scientific_limit: No claim of measured micelle formation, CMC, PAH loading, solubilization improvement, or treatment/remediation success without primary reported measurements.

chapters.title: THE QUESTION
chapters.speech: Some aromatic pollutants barely dissolve in water. The project asked whether a polymer could give those molecules somewhere else to go.
chapters.source: Project UREP19-110-1-014: hydrophobic PAH solubility, theoretical premise, no specific experimental outcome.

chapters.title: THE PRESENTATION
chapters.speech: At a research meeting in 2017, we presented the theoretical and experimental study. The poster records that question, not an unrestricted claim of environmental cleanup.
chapters.source: Owner 2017 photo showing the actual micelle research poster and co-researchers; archival record, not quantitative assay.

chapters.title: TWO OPPOSING BLOCKS
chapters.speech: A diblock copolymer contains segments that respond differently to water. That contrast can make self-assembly favorable, but only under the right conditions.
chapters.source: Block-copolymer self-assembly, idealized conceptual physical chemistry; project proposal.

chapters.title: A POSSIBLE CORE
chapters.speech: The proposed micelle places water-compatible segments outside and hydrophobic segments inward. Pollutant partitioning into a core is a hypothesis requiring measurement.
chapters.source: Micelle hypothesis, illustrative arrangement; no DLS, CMC, or PAH uptake data implied.

chapters.title: IT DEPENDS ON CONDITIONS
chapters.speech: Composition, concentration and mixing can change what forms. A drawing of a neat micelle tells us nothing about what actually assembled in the vial.
chapters.source: Flory-Huggins-type compatibility argument and concentration effects; no simulated numeric measurements.

chapters.title: THE ACTUAL MATERIAL
chapters.speech: I kept this specimen photograph from the project period. It documents a material in my hand; its appearance alone cannot establish size, loading or removal efficiency.
chapters.source: Owner 2017 photo of bottle/copolymer sample; identity, composition and analytical results cannot be inferred from pixels.

chapters.title: THE UNFORTUNATE TRIALS
chapters.speech: And there was this notebook: a series of unfortunate trials. The archive records the struggle, without proving which experimental procedure failed from the photograph alone.
chapters.source: Owner's photographed Maxi notebook with handwritten note 'A series of unfortunate trials'; no analytical results shown.

chapters.title: WHAT REMAINS TO TEST
chapters.speech: A research question can survive an unsuccessful attempt. The experiment still must answer whether the polymer assembled and whether the pollutant was actually recovered.
chapters.source: Owner project aims, assessment requirements. No successful PAH recovery or pollutant-remediation claim.

human_review: NOT APPROVED: scientific, rights, visual and speech screening outstanding
